text: NOAA's archived copy of its 12 November 2026 discussion keeps the El Niño Advisory and the outlook of a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027.

text: The Bureau of Meteorology reports a weekly relative Niño3.4 value of +2.67 °C for the week ending 22 November 2026, below the event's peak so far of +2.88 °C.

text: The Bureau says most models expect warming in the tropical Pacific to peak in December or January and to stay above El Niño thresholds into the southern autumn of 2027 (March to May 2027).

text: The Bureau notes that a strong Niño3.4 signal does not necessarily mean strong impacts.

text: The Bureau reports a weekly Indian Ocean Dipole index of +0.53 °C for the week ending 22 November 2026, and expects the positive Indian Ocean Dipole to weaken and return to neutral in early southern summer.
